name: Bluetooth speaker through a hotel room's window wall, 2026-11-14
source: Alejandro, phone sound-level app, A-weighted. Dimensions by phone measurement. See hotel_speaker_test.md.

room.note: 23 ft x 11 ft, ceiling 8 ft (7 ft 1 in for the first foot at the entrance)

window.note: 6 ft x 3 ft 3 in. Assumed centred in the wall: its position was not measured.

speaker.note: About 1 ft from the wall. Level read about 1 ft from the speaker.

listener.note: About 4 ft from the window wall, inside

as_predicted.note: What was assumed when the predictions were given: brick wall, a double-pane window that opens, speaker aimed at the window's centre.

confirmed.note: What Alejandro confirmed by eye afterwards: stucco wall, a window that does not open but leaks like one that does, speaker under 1 ft off-centre (0.5 ft used).
